summary: Commonwealth of Puerto Rico. Unincorporated organized territory of the us with local self-government; republican form of territorial government with separate executive, legislative, and judicial branches; note - reference puerto rican federal relations act, 2 march 1917, as amended by public law 600, 3 july 1950.
rulers: President Donald J. TRUMP (since 20 January 2025); Governor Jenniffer GONZÁLEZ-COLÓN (since 2 January 2025)
government: unincorporated organized territory of the US with local self-government; republican form of territorial government with separate executive, legislative, and judicial branches; note - reference Puerto Rican Federal Relations Act, 2 March 1917, as amended by Public Law 600, 3 July 1950
economy: US Caribbean island territorial economy; hit hard by COVID-19 and hurricanes; declining labor force and job growth after a decade of continuous recession; capital-based industry and tourism; high poverty; energy import-dependent GDP (PPP): $141.344 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: Puerto Rico Police; Puerto Rico (US) National Guard (Guardia Nacional de Puerto Rico or GNPR) (2025)
origin: none (territory of the US with commonwealth status)
